verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no guided first-time setup flow, setup wizard, or end-user instructions for registering the key with accounts. What it does contain is adjacent: the ykman CLI and Yubico Authenticator handle device configuration and firmware checks, and demo.yubico.com is a developer-oriented browser demo for testing registration, not a walkthrough for enrolling with your own accounts. A community report (comm-13) also notes novices can miss the right guidance and enroll keys without a PIN.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts
